items.period: Shang dynasty oracle-bone script; specimen reference 前2.32.4 / 合37459 per the previously inspected Commons and Academia Sinica records
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of a cataloged oracle-bone form of 八. Oracle-bone contexts already use 八 as a numeral; the traditional separation interpretation remains disputed.
items.alt: Modern vector redraw of an oracle-script glyph identified by its source record as 八.
items.selection_reason: A sourced early-script candidate illustrating the attested graph form; the caption distinguishes the modern redraw from an artifact photograph and keeps the origin interpretation open.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication, as stated on the Commons file page for the redraw and cited source picture.

items.period: Warring States bronze-script style; source cited as 丙辰方壺 西清19·3
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of a Warring States bronze-script form of 八, sourced to the cited vessel. It offers a graphic comparison with the oracle-script candidate, but does not establish what the graph originally represented.
items.alt: Modern vector redraw of a bronze-script glyph identified by its source record as 八.
items.selection_reason: Adds a separately sourced bronze-script comparison while avoiding a claim that the form proves the graph's origin or a precise line-by-line evolution.
items.rights: Public domain; the Commons file page states the representation is released for unrestricted reuse.

limitations.text: These candidates are digitally redrawn forms, not photographs of inscribed artifacts. Source pages establish their stated attribution and reuse status; the glyph pixels were not visually inspected here, and the images do not settle the disputed origin of 八.
